content: AI shopping assistant patterns (Algolia/CrossML/BigCommerce/Sendbird): ground the LLM in the product catalog via RAG over structured metadata; always return verifiable product links/cards to build trust; place the assistant at high-intent journey moments (discovery, PDP, cart); adapt recommendations to constraints stated in conversation (budget, scent family); keep shipping/return policies visible; fallback gracefully on LLM errors.
